queued: Kit queued (a video conversion may be in progress)…
tooLong: Preparing the kit is taking too long: try again in a moment.
partsHelp: Each part is a single .psd file, identical to the one in the full kit (same layers, same names). Send it back as it is: only that part is updated, the others stay as they are.
partsGen: Kit generation: {s} s (once, then each part downloads right away).
partsWeights: The size of each part is shown once the kit is generated.
